run_experiment.py.description: Experiment execution script with stratified round-robin scenario assignment and iterative decompression

raw_observations.json.description: All 720 HTTP observations with compressed/decompressed hashes, encoding scenarios, and decompression latencies

fix_applied.description: Replaced parent's random scenario assignment (scenario_rng.choice(ENCODING_SCENARIOS)) with deterministic round-robin (scenarios[request_index % 6]) passed via X-Requested-Scenario header. Proxy connectivity test uses separate RNG (seed=SEED+9999) that does not consume from measured-request sequence.
fix_applied.parent_defect: RNG shift from shared proxy-test draw consumed one draw before measured plan, shifting triple_br away from valid_token positions (0/180 reps in parent)
fix_applied.fix_method: Stratified round-robin: scenario = ENCODING_SCENARIOS[request_index % 6] pre-assigned per request, passed to proxy via X-Requested-Scenario header
fix_applied.expected_coverage: 80 requests per condition, 6 scenarios => 13-14 observations per scenario per condition, guaranteeing >=1 triple_br per state
